name: review-canvas
description: Review a pull request on an infinite canvas, file by file in the order an agent planned.

scripts.build: npm -w @review-canvas/shared run build && npm -w @review-canvas/web run build && npm -w @review-canvas/server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @review-canvas/shared run build && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit
